Interface ViewController

All Known Subinterfaces:
SceneController
All Known Implementing Classes:
BoardGameAreaController, BoardSelfPanelController, BoardViewController, LobbyViewController, NetworkSetupViewController, NickViewController, PlayerViewController, SplashViewController, TotemPickViewController, TribePopupController, WaitingViewController, WinnerViewController
public interface ViewController
Interface for all view controllers. Implement only the methods relevant to a given screen; the defaults are intentional no-ops.

  • Method Details

    • update

      default void update(LocalGameState state)
      Called by the ClientStateListenerGui when a new game state snapshot is received from the server. Each controller decides how to handle the update based on the current game phase and its own state.
      Parameters:
      state - the game state given by the server

    • setLobby

      default void setLobby(LobbyDto lobby)
      Called by the SceneRouter and overridden by the WaitingViewController. Shows the current lobby state in the waiting view.
      Parameters:
      lobby - last lobby DTO state

    • showLobbies

      default void showLobbies(List<LobbyDto> lobbies)
      Called by ClientStateListenerGui when a lobby update is received. It's ovverridden by the LobbyViewController to show the list of lobbies.
      Parameters:
      lobbies - list of lobbies DTO

    • showLobbyState

      default void showLobbyState(LobbyDto lobby)
      Called by ClientStateListenerGui when an update for a specific lobby is received. Overridden by LobbyViewController to navigate to the waiting view when joining, and by WaitingViewController to update with current lobby details (for example players count)
      Parameters:
      lobby - the updated state of the lobby

    • showWinners

      default void showWinners(List<PlayerDto> players, List<String> winners)
      Called when the game ends prematurely (for example due to disconnections). Displays the winner(s) without detailed end-game scoring breakdown. Overridden by WinnerViewController to populate the end screen with basic player and winner information.
      Parameters:
      players - the list of players in the game
      winners - the list of winner usernames

    • showWinners

      default void showWinners(List<PlayerDto> players, List<String> winners, EndGameScoringDto scoring)
      Called when the game ends normally after all rounds are completed. Displays the winner(s) alongside a detailed breakdown of the final points. By default, it delegates to showWinners(List, List) if detailed scoring is not supported. Overridden by WinnerViewController to show full categorized score details.
      Parameters:
      players - the list of players in the game
      winners - the list of winner usernames
      scoring - the detailed scoring breakdown for all players
